_doc: Same shape as DiaithirRPG content/tech_ages.json. Items beat namespaces. Calibres follow the decided pointblank ages (.45 and .357 Age V), the rest Age VII; the musket cartridge is the Age IV baseline. Set families gate in data/diaithirgear/set_bonuses. 'families' are the Age at which each set bonus switches on (set_bonuses/*.json age 1..9); Silent Gems gems follow silentgems (III).
